messages:
marta: heads-up: i'm about to request a soft-pin of SDK -> 3.0 for a short window while we validate q-compact-v4 runtime telemetry. can ops + runtime weigh in?

deploy-bot: scheduled action: proposed pin: sdk=3.0 scope=hosted,dedicated duration=2h reason='canary telemetry mismatch with runtime 2.14 for q-compact-v4' requestor=marta

sofia: quick question — do we expect any client-facing API surface changes? if not, pin should be low-risk.

rahul: there is one subtle change in client backcompat: streaming chunk headers changed order in 3.0 but we have shims in SDK. i've validated basic flows, but longpoll streamers may hit reorder bugs. recommend tight canary and alert.

jamie: +1 to tight canary. suggest enabling staging region first (eu-west-staging) and monitor error-rate and 99th latency for 30m before wider roll.

leo: ops note: pin will route hosters to runtime-compat path that disables kernel X fallback. if canary shows bit flips on longseq we'll need immediate rollback. define rollback signal now?

marta: rollback triggers proposal: > 1% increase in 5xx or > 15% regression in p99 token latency for canary cohort over baseline. if hit, deploy-bot should auto-unpin and rollback to sdk=2.8 for affected regions.

sre-oncall: noted. i'll wire an alert dashboard: query: `sum(rate(errors[5m])) / sum(rate(reqs[5m]))` by region and `histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(token_latency_bucket[5m]))`. will post links when ready.

sofia: release-note item: mention SDK 3.0 short pin for q-compact-v4 canary, include guidance for customers using streaming SDKs to upgrade if they see reordering. i'll draft.

deploy-bot: pending approval from runtime and ops. to approve run: `/deploybot approve-pin 3329876543 --approvers="runtime,ops"`

rahul: approved from runtime side. verified evens: no model quality delta on the canary prompt set.

leo: ops approved for eu-west-staging ONLY. hold global expansion until 30m mark.

marta: executing approval for staging now. running small canary (5% traffic).

deploy-bot: action: pinned sdk=3.0 for model_group=q-compact-v4 in eu-west-staging. canary_traffic=5% started at 3329876548

sofia: draft release note: "Temporary routing to SDK 3.0 for q-compact-v4 canary window. Users on streaming SDKs: expect potential chunk reorder; report regressions to support." any edits?

jamie: add mention of rollback criteria and that we will unpin automatically if thresholds exceeded. keeps customers informed.

marta: canary 15m update: p99 token latency +3%, errors stable. still within thresholds. continuing to monitor.

sre-oncall: saved dashboard here: https://grafana.internal/r/abc123 (alert rules attached).

rahul: running synthetic prompt set now. no behavioral drift so far.

marta: 30m canary check: p99 +2.7%, errors +0.2%. below rollback. expanding to 30% traffic in eu-west and us-east-staging.

deploy-bot: action: expanded canary to 30% for staging regions at 3329876570

leo: ops note: warming nodes for expanded cohort. watching GPU mem pressure — one node spiked OOM then recovered; not sure if related.

marta: if OOM repeats, we'll scale back. for now keep watch.

sofia: finalizing release note with rollback criteria and timeframe. publishing to changelog-lite after full canary completes.

marta: 1h45m — canary passed in staging. no rollback triggers. planning global unpin lift tomorrow during change window 02:00-04:00 UTC with a full SDK 3.0 rollout for q-compact-v4.

rahul: recommend a small hotfix branch ready (cherry-pick) in case we need urgent shim tweak post-rollout. i'll open PR and link it here.

deploy-bot: note: schedule global rollout: `/deploybot schedule-rollout --ts=3329970000 --scope=global --note="sdk3-global-rollout-q-compact-v4"` (pending ops final)

leo: ops thumbs-up for the planned window. will have runbook on standby.

marta: thanks everyone. will follow up with the release-note link and the PR. tagging @sofia for release-note publish when global goes green. :thumbsup:
